function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

Shashi Tej Reddy is an Indian entrepreneur and philanthropist best known for his work in the technology and education sectors. He co‑founded **TechBridge**, a startup that provides affordable tech solutions to rural communities across India, and later founded **EduReach**, a non‑profit organization that builds digital learning hubs in underserved areas.

Reddy holds a B.Tech in Computer Science from IIT Bombay and an MBA from Stanford Graduate School of Business. He has been recognized by Forbes India’s “30 Under 30” list for his contributions to social entrepreneurship and was named one of the “Top 10 Young Innovators” by MIT Technology Review in 2019.

In addition to his business ventures, Shashi Tej Reddy serves on the advisory board of several NGOs focused on digital literacy and climate resilience. He frequently speaks at international conferences on sustainable development and inclusive technology.
